name: Spiteful People
overview: Scripture reveals that spiteful people reject God's messengers and resist His loving calls, as seen in Jerusalem's rejection of the prophets despite God's desire to gather His children (Matthew 23:37). The permanence of God's word stands in contrast to human stubbornness (Matthew 24:35), and those who do not believe in the Son remain under God's wrath (John 3:36). Believers, called servants and apostles of Christ (Colossians 1:1; James 1:1), are encouraged to overcome such opposition, with the promise of authority and victory for those who remain faithful to Christ's works until the end (Revelation 2:26).
